notes.title: Steam Playtest Opens as MIX Showcase begins
notes.content:
My Pet Hooligan was selected for the LA Comic Con MIX Showcase! If you'll be in Los Angeles, you can come check us out in person showcasing at the Mix booth from September 26-29. You can also find us during the Mix digital event on Steam.
To celebrate: we are opening a Steam playtest on Friday 26th of September

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539706/d148dfca0bf1e046b3d42e5088a057050efaf3e5.png"]To get in: go to our Steam page and request access to the playtest.
+Wishlist the game on Steam while you wander over to the page :) 

- The playtest will last until October 13th.- Then, Steam Next Fest begins and our demo drops on Steam.
Progress you make during the playtest & demo will be saved if you end up purchasing the game.

notes.title: Game Update - Early Access: Fully Loaded!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539706/79547cb53b2407c1c4cb7da87d71e8d84510cbd0.jpg"]
August game update is live! Here are the highlights: 
Pledge allegiance to a Faction, raise your reputation & unlock faction drip
Going deeper into the Faction lore, the full faction Reputation system unlocks next release

New Battle Zone: Big Carrot Energy Stadium
Explore the Rogue Jumpers faction area in Hangout and competitive modes.

Updated Skateboard Physics
It’s way more physical now


Skateboard and Water Pistol Skins added to the game
Change your skins in the inventory 

All reload animations are now hooked up and in the game
Certain weapons can now be interrupted and only half reloaded

Weapon Movement Speed Modifiers added
Weapons now impact your movement speed, helps melee weapons the most


Melee Weapons Buffed
Attack mid-air with the improved leap and cut the distance to enemies at ease


Performance Improvements
Your average FPS should slightly higher all around now


Founders Pass has been removed from menu
We transition to a new Faction Progression system in the next release


Let us know on discord how you feel about the updates:https://discord.gg/wMpCE6qSEsPS. Show your support and wishlist the game on Steam

notes.title: Hooligans rolling into the Steam forums
notes.content:
Hey Hooligans! Our Community has lived on discord ever since 2021. High time to kick off our Steam posts as we will be launching here too! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539706/02e9737efa3eddeb3883d061fe65fc026e1b9e56.png"]Lets treat the newbuns first with updated game info:
My Pet Hooligan is a fast-paced 3rd-person shooter-platformer set in a colorful dystopian city, developed by former Pixar animators and EA developers.

You play as a rebellious rabbit, battling enemies with an arsenal of comical weapons from flamethrowers to toilet plungers.

Use skateboards for fast traversal, platform for better vantage points, cause chaos in combat, join a faction to rebel against corporate robot overlords, and fight for control over Hooliland City.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539706/feb19cf123def2a8378f9d6ec219c81e5d955476.png"]What makes this game special?
The game characters, music, and environments stood out the most to content creators.

The game’s rebellious tone and creative style reflect our studio’s background in animation :eyes:

The skateboarding mechanic is a player favorite (we doubled down on it thanks to community feedback <3)

While the current Early access features PvP modes, a hangout space, and a tutorial. Co-op modes, faction systems, and more content are on the way!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539706/e4fbd2e1c4d8f3d1b6160b5aa6c9e60eda781338.png"]Giving back to the community is important to us.
Basics first: we have given to our community the dopest game merch such as skateboards, hoodies & custom XBOXes. Yet... 
We have shared our community rewards for all of the below:
a) Multiple Leaderboard competitions (for the most active players)

b) Tens of Tournaments (for both pro & casual players)

c) Months of UGC contests (top content each month)



Winners received their rewards quickly and hassle-free through our blockchain integration!

Note: blockchain is never a requirement to play My Pet Hooligan.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539706/f68d5a6c7a2eb57e25017c6b2533631275ccded9.png"]
In our next posts we spit about things like: where the game is going, the cool things happening in our community and announcing the dopest events!


Our Discord is your best bet to get exclusive sneak peaks, impact our new EXCITING community proposals and start helping the development of this beautiful videogame.
Join The Rebellion here! https://discord.gg/wMpCE6qSEs 
(official My Pet Hooligan discord)

PS. Strengthen the Rebellion by wishlisting the game on Steam <3
